new_claims.statement: For any original-coordinate cross block B of rank at least three, let W3=sum of squared physical 3x3 cross minors and w be the determinant-weighted minor law. Any minor law mu with row inclusion marginals <=1/2 gives ||p_Q||inf <=(3e/sqrt(2))exp(D(mu||w)/6)W3^(-1/6), with arbitrary same-bank curvature and arbitrary outside couplings; the density is continuous because phi_Q is L1.

If delta_row is the probability that two iid determinant-weighted physical 3x3 minors have disjoint row triples, then ||p_Q||inf <=(3e/sqrt(2))delta_row^(-1/6)W3(B)^(-1/6); transpose gives the column version.

Small row-disjointness delta_row produces a fixed physical row triple H with W3(B without H rows)<=delta_row W3(B); small column-disjointness similarly gives L. If both are small, at least 1-delta_row-delta_col of determinant-weighted three-minor mass touches both H and L.
If T^(0) is the squared 3x3 minor mass of symmetric A over disjoint row/column triples, then for a random physical bipartition E W3(A[I,J])=T^(0)/64.

unresolved_implication: QFORM-COMPOUND-HUB-OR-OVERLAP-COMPILER-v1: starting from e3(A^2)>=1, pay the disjoint-minor branch by random cut plus the new crossminor L1 theorem unless it creates the six-coordinate compound hub; aggregate the hub and overlap-one/two/principal classes into completed physical-pair, pivot/Schur, zero-diagonal/principal, grouped-star, ridge or diffuse exits without selecting a tiny minor.
